name: L001-1
title: BAB/L/001 No. 1, 4 Aug 1837
text:
% BAB/L/001, Science Museum Group Collection, document aa110000065.
% The cover (image 222/593) lists the sheet's two programs; this is the first,
% the upper table of the opened sheet (image 222/594, top half).
% Read from the zoom images at full resolution. Accents are written ': b' is b′.

Sheet BAB/L/001
No. 1
Date 4 Aug 1837          "No 1. 4 Aug 1837."   % cover; also "4 Aug 1837" at the top right of the table
Title "Elimination between two equations of the first degree ax + by + c = 0  a'x + b'y + c' = 0 which is equivalent to calculating the value of x from the eqn x = (bc'-b'c)/(b'a-ba')"
Image 222/593 cover
Image 222/594 upper table

Letters a b c a' b' c'
Unknowns x y
Equation a x + b y + c = 0
Equation a' x + b' y + c' = 0
Find x = (bc'-b'c)/(b'a-ba')    "x = bc'-b'c / b'a-ba'"   % the heading, and the cover

% "The number of variables = 6 viz v1=a, v2=b, v3=c; v4=a', v5=b', v6=c'"  (cover)
Store v1 = a, v2 = b, v3 = c, v4 = a', v5 = b', v6 = c'
Working v7

% Columns: Numbers of Operations | Nature of oper. | variables in Mill | Store v1..v7 | right-hand column.
% Store columns are headed +ax +by +c (v1 v2 v3), +a'x +b'y +c' (v4 v5 v6), v7.
% A store cell is written only where the sheet writes one.
Op 1     ×  | b'a                 | v1 0, v5 0, v7 b'a        | v7 = v5·v1
Op 2     ×  | b'c                 | v1 b'c, v3 0              | v1' = v5·v3
Op 3     ×  | ba'                 | v2 0, v3 ba', v4 0        | v3' = v2·v4
Op 4     ×  | bc'                 | v2 bc', v6 0              | v2' = v2·v6
Op 5     −  | bc'-b'c             | v1 0, v2 0, v4 bc'-b'c    | v4' = v2'-v1'
Op 6     −  | b'a-ba'             | v1 b'a-ba', v3 0, v7 0    | v1'' = v7-v3'
Op 7  *  ÷  | (bc'-b'c)/(b'a-ba') | v1 0, v3 =x, v4 0         | x = v3'' = v4'/v1''

Composition x = v3'' = v4'/v1'' = (v2'-v1')/(v7-v3') = (v2·v6-v5·v3)/(v5·v1-v2·v4) = (bc'-b'c)/(b'a-ba')

% "Number of operations great = 5 small = 2 Total number of operations = 7
%  Number of variables = 6 No of working variables = 1 Total number of variables occupied = 7"
% The same figures are on the cover.
States great 5, small 2, total 7, variables 6, working 1, occupied 7

Remark "It at first appeared that variables v7 and v3' might have been saved by making b'a-ba' at the fourth operation but this would have caused the table of b' made in the third operation to be destroyed and it must have been recomputed in the operation for b'c thus causing the loss of about ten turns of the hand."

name: L001-2
title: BAB/L/001 No. 2, 5 Aug 1837
text:
% BAB/L/001, Science Museum Group Collection, document aa110000065.
% The second program of the sheet: the lower table of the opened sheet
% (image 222/594, bottom half). The cover dates it "No 2. Aug. 5"; the table
% itself is not dated. Read from the zoom images at full resolution.

Sheet BAB/L/001
No. 2
Date 5 Aug 1837          "No 2. Aug. 5"   % cover
Title "Elimination between two equations of the first degree ax + by + c = 0 & a'x + b'y + c' = 0 which is equivalent to calculating x & y from the equations x = (bc'-b'c)/(b'a-ba') & y = (a'c-ac')/(b'a-ba')"
Image 222/593 cover
Image 222/594 lower table
Image 222/595 back: "C, C or C before any number signifies the Complement of that number as Ca means complement of a"

Letters a b c a' b' c'
Unknowns x y
Equation a x + b y + c = 0
Equation a' x + b' y + c' = 0
Find x = (bc'-b'c)/(b'a-ba')
Find y = (a'c-ac')/(b'a-ba')

Store v1 = a, v2 = b, v3 = c, v4 = a', v5 = b', v6 = c'
Working v7 v8 v9

% Ca, Cc, Cb: written with a looped capital C, which the back of the sheet defines.
% Rows 8-10 have no operation and nothing in the mill column.
Op 1     ×  | b'a                 | v1 0, v5 0, v7 b'a, v8 Ca          | v7 = v5·v1
Op 2     ×  | b'c                 | v1 b'c, v3 0, v5 Cc                | v1' = v5·v3
Op 3     ×  | ba'                 | v2 0, v3 ba', v4 0, v9 Cb          | v3' = v2·v4
Op 4     ×  | bc'                 | v2 bc', v6 0                       | v2' = v2·v6
Op 5     −  | bc'-b'c             | v1 0, v2 0, v6 bc'-b'c             | v6' = v2'-v1'
Op 6     −  | b'a-ba'             | v2 b'a-ba', v3 0, v7 0             | v2'' = v7-v3'
Op 7  *  ÷  | (bc'-b'c)/(b'a-ba') | v2 0, v4 =x, v6 0, v7 =x           | x = v4' = v6'/v2''
Op 8        |                     | v1 a, v8 0                         | v1'' = v1 = a
Op 9        |                     | v2 b, v9 0                         | v2''' = v2 = b
Op 10       |                     | v3 c, v5 0                         | v3'' = v3 = c
Op 11    ×  | ax                  | v1 0, v4 0, v5 ax                  | v5'' = v1''·v4'
Op 12    −  | -c-ax               | v1 -c-ax, v3 0, v5 0               | v1''' = -v3''-v5''
Op 13 *  ÷  | (-c-ax)/b           | v1 0, v2 0, v5 =y                  | y = v5''' = v1'''/v2'''

% "Composition"
Composition x = v4' = v6'/v2'' = (v2'-v1')/(v7-v3') = (v2·v6-v5·v3)/(v5·v1-v2·v4) = (bc'-b'c)/(b'a-ba')
Composition y = v5''' = v1'''/v2''' = (-v3''-v5'')/b = (-c-v1''·v4')/b = (-c-ax)/b = (-c-a(bc'-b'c)/(b'a-ba'))/b = (-cb'a+cba'-c'ba+cb'a)/(b(b'a-ba')) = (a'c-ac')/(b'a-ba')

% "Number of operations great = 7 small = 6 Total number of operations = 13
%  Number of variables = 6 No of working variables = 3 Total no of variables occupied = 9"
% The same figures are on the cover.
States great 7, small 6, total 13, variables 6, working 3, occupied 9

Unrun "pencil, right of the counts: '6 Mult = 18 / 1 Div = 5 / 6 add = 1', ruled off, '24'; a word above the column of figures, perhaps 'Mov'"
Unrun "pencil, beside the right-hand column: the value of each operation in letters (= b'a, = b'c, ...)"
Unrun "pencil, faint, centre: 'ε^(a + bx + cx² + ...) = A + Bx + Cx² + ...'"
Unrun "pencil, foot of the sheet: '085', '075 035', '6 66', 'a fa fa·a' (unclear)"

name: L002
title: BAB/L/002 No. 2, 14 Aug 1837
text:
% BAB/L/002, Science Museum Group Collection, document aa110000066.
% The opened sheet (image 222/624), one table of 30 operations. The cover
% (222/622) is dated "14 Aug 1837 No 2". Read from the zoom images at full
% resolution.

Sheet BAB/L/002
No. 2
Date 14 Aug 1837          "14 Aug 1837 No 2"   % cover
Title "Computation of λ0, λ1, λ2, &c from (A0 + A1x + A2x² + &c)/(a + bx) = λ0 + λ1x + λ2x² + &c by Means of the relation λm = (Am - bλm-1)/a = Nm/a & λ0 = A0/a"
Image 222/622 cover: "Notation for the coeffecients of the powers of x in (A0 + A1x + A2x² + .... Aix^i)/(a + bx) = λ0 + λ1x + λ2x² .... λmx^m, where λ0 = A0/a and λm = (Am - bλm-1)/a"
Image 222/624 the table
Image 222/626 back

Letters a b A0 A1 A2 A3 A4 A5 A6
Find λ0 = A0/a

% The sheet heads v1 "a", v2 "b", and v8 to v14 "A0" to "A6"; v3 to v7 have
% no heading.
Store v1 = a, v2 = b, v8 = A0, v9 = A1, v10 = A2, v11 = A3, v12 = A4, v13 = A5, v14 = A6
Working v3 v4 v5 v6 v7

% The table has no right-hand column of formulas: each row is the operation,
% the mill's result and the cells. "Com a" and "Com b" are written so, not
% with the looped C of BAB/L/001; here Ca and Cb. λ and N are the sheet's;
% =λ1 marks where the sheet first writes λ1, so that later rows can use it.
% A mark like > stands left of the operation column between operations 1
% and 2, 5 and 6, 10 and 11, 15 and 16, 20 and 21, 25 and 26: before each
% bringing in of b, where each cycle begins.
Op 1     ÷  | A0/a      | v1 0, v3 Ca, v6 =λ0, v7 λ0, v8 0 |
Op 2     ×  | bλ0       | v1 Cb, v2 0, v4 bλ0, v6 0 |
Op 3     −  | A1-bλ0    | v4 0, v5 =N1, v9 0 |
Op 4        |           | v2 a, v3 0 |
Op 5     ÷  | N1/a      | v2 0, v3 Ca, v5 0, v6 =λ1, v8 λ1 |   % the mill's N has no legible subscript
Op 6        |           | v1 0, v2 b |
Op 7     ×  | bλ1       | v1 Cb, v2 0, v4 bλ1, v6 0 |
Op 8     −  | A2-bλ1    | v4 0, v5 =N2, v10 0 |
Op 9        |           | v2 a, v3 0 |
Op 10    ÷  | N2/a      | v2 0, v3 Ca, v5 0, v6 =λ2, v9 λ2 |
Op 11       |           | v1 0, v2 b |
Op 12    ×  | bλ2       | v1 Cb, v2 0, v4 bλ2, v6 0 |
Op 13    −  | A3-bλ2    | v4 0, v5 =N3, v11 0 |   % the sign is − with a pencil stroke through it, which makes it look like +
Op 14       |           | v2 a, v3 0 |
Op 15    ÷  | N3/a      | v2 0, v3 Ca, v5 0, v6 =λ3, v10 λ3 |
Op 16       |           | v1 0, v2 b |
Op 17    ×  | bλ3       | v1 Cb, v2 0, v4 bλ3, v6 0 |
Op 18    −  | A4-bλ3    | v4 0, v5 =N4, v12 0 |
Op 19       |           | v2 a, v3 0 |
Op 20    ÷  | N4/a      | v2 0, v3 Ca, v5 0, v6 =λ4, v11 λ4 |
Op 21       |           | v1 0, v2 b |
Op 22    ×  | bλ4       | v1 Cb, v2 0, v4 bλ4, v6 0 |
Op 23    −  | A5-bλ4    | v4 0, v5 =N5, v13 0 |
Op 24       |           | v2 a, v3 0 |
Op 25    ÷  | N5/a      | v2 0, v3 Ca, v5 0, v6 =λ5, v12 λ5 |
Op 26       |           | v1 0, v2 b |
Op 27    ×  | bλ5       | v1 Cb, v2 0, v4 bλ5, v6 0 |   % "Com b" in v1 is faint, lighter than the rest
Op 28    −  | A6-bλ5    | v4 0, v5 =N6, v14 0 |
Op 29       |           | v2 a, v3 0 |
Op 30    ÷  | N6/a      | v2 0, v5 0, v13 =λ6 |   % no Com a, and nothing in v6: a and λ6 are not needed again

% Not on the sheet, an observation: the last division lays no complement of
% a and writes λ6 only in v13, and operation 27's Com b is faint; a and b are
% kept only while a later operation needs them.
Unrun "a column of numbers 1 to 30 between v13 and v14, repeating the numbers of the operations"
Unrun "cover, pencil, faint, read in part: '1 Division gets λ0'; '1 Multiplication {2} Subtraction {3} Bring in a number 4 Division gets λ1 = 2 large & 2 small = 4 operations'; '1 Bring in a number 2 Multiplication {3} Subtraction {4} Bring in a number 5 Division gets λm = 2 large & 3 small = 5 operations' (the counts not certain)"
Unrun "cover, pencil, faint: a ruled grid of four labelled rows of 0s and 1s, the first label perhaps 'Division', the last perhaps 'General'; not read"
example: (2 + 3x + 3x² + 3x³ + 3x⁴ + 3x⁵ + x⁶)/(2 + x) = 1 + x + x² + x³ + x⁴ + x⁵ (λ6 = 0)

name: L004-1
title: BAB/L/004 No. 4.1, 16 Aug 1837
text:
% BAB/L/004, Science Museum Group Collection, document aa110001607.
% The first of three tables on the opened sheet (image 222/630, top left).
% The cover (222/628), headed "Notation", "16 Aug 1837 No 4", numbers the
% three 1, 2, 3; the sheet is dated "16 Augt 1837" at its top left and
% "Aug 1837" at its top right. Read from the zoom images at full resolution.

Sheet BAB/L/004
No. 4.1
Date 16 Aug 1837          "16 Aug 1837 No 4"   % cover
Title "Determination of x from the Equation ax - b = 0"
Image 222/628 cover: "1. of the determination of x from the equation ax - b = 0", "1 Division"
Image 222/630 the first table
Image 222/632 back: "No 4 16 Aug 1837"

Letters a b
Unknowns x
Equation a x - b = 0

% The columns are headed "+ax" and "+b" (the sign before b read as +,
% though the equation is ax - b = 0), with v1, v2 beneath; v3 has no heading.
Store v1 = a, v2 = b
Working v3

Op 1     ÷  | b/a       | v1 0, v2 0, v3 =x |      % the mill column reads "b/a = x"

% Cover: "a great operation = 1"; "variables = 2 / working do = 1 / total var. = 3".
States great 1, variables 2, working 1, occupied 3

Unrun "a pencil stroke, like a long 0 or bracket, in the column left of v1"

name: L004-2
title: BAB/L/004 No. 4.2, 16 Aug 1837
text:
% BAB/L/004, Science Museum Group Collection, document aa110001607.
% The second of three tables on the opened sheet (image 222/630, middle
% left), and the "Composition" to the right of it. Numbered 2 on the cover.
% Read from the zoom images at full resolution.

Sheet BAB/L/004
No. 4.2
Date 16 Aug 1837          "16 Aug 1837 No 4"   % cover
Title "Reduction of the two equations ax + by + c = 0, a'x + b'y + c' = 0 to a single equation of the form Hx - M = 0"
Image 222/628 cover: "2. Reduction of the two Equations ax + by + c = 0 & a'x + b'y + c' = 0 to a single one of the form Hx - M = 0"
Image 222/630 the second table and the composition

Letters a b c a' b' c' x
Unknowns x y
Equation a x + b y + c = 0
Equation a' x + b' y + c' = 0

Store v1 = a, v2 = b, v3 = c, v4 = a', v5 = b', v6 = c'
Working v7

% No right-hand column of formulas. The mill column writes "b'/b = A",
% "Aa - a' = H", "c' - Ac = M"; the cells "A", "H", "M". =A, =H, =M mark
% where the sheet first writes each.
% In pencil, fainter than the ink: "v8" at the head of a column after v7,
% "A" in it at row 1 and "0" at row 3; and "M" in v7 at row 5. Not run.
Op 1     ÷  | b'/b      | v2 0, v5 0, v7 =A |
Op 2     ×  | Aa        | v1 0, v2 Aa, v7 0 |
Op 3     ×  | Ac        | v3 0, v5 Ac |             % nothing else in the row: A is in no column (v7 was left at zero by row 2)
Op 4     −  | Aa-a'     | v1 =H, v2 0, v4 0 |       % the species "−" has a pencil mark beside it
Op 5     −  | c'-Ac     | v2 =M, v5 0, v6 0 |

% "Composition", to the right of the table:
%   v1 = a  v2 = b  v3 = c  v4 = a'  v5 = b'  v6 = c'
%   v7 = v5/v2;  v2' = v7 v1;  v3' = v7 v3;  v1' = v2' - v4;  v2'' = v6 - v5'
% (the table writes Ac in v5, not v3: the composition calls it v3' here and
% v5' in the next line). Then "result = v1'x + v2'' = …"; the word
% "result" is left out here, so that the chain starts at v1'x + v2''.
Composition v1'x + v2'' = (v2'-v4)x - (v6-v3') = (v7v1-a')x - (c'-v7v3) = ((v5/v2)a-a')x - (c'-(v5/v2)v3) = ((b'/b)a-a')x - (c'-(b'/b)c) = (ab'-a'b)x - (bc'-b'c) = 0
% Each member after the first is written "= 0" on the sheet, so the chain is
% of equations (the last, b times the one before it, agrees as one).

% Cover, right of 2: "variables = 6 / working do = 1 / Total do = 7";
% "great op. = 3 / small do = 2 / Total operations = 5".
States great 3, small 2, total 5, variables 6, working 1, occupied 7

Remark "The reduction is effected by making the coeffecient of one of the unknowns in one of the equations equal to the coeffecient of the same unknown in the other equation and subtracting the results as ax + by + c = 0, a'x + b'y + c' = 0; (b'/b).ax + (b'/b).by + (b'/b).c = 0, a'x + b'y + c' = 0 whence ((b'/b)a - a')x - (c' - (b'/b)c) = 0 or Hx - M = 0"
Remark "Had H = b'a - ba' M = bc' - b'c 4 Multns must have been made instead of 2 —— and 1 Division"
Unrun "cover, pencil, faint: a ruled grid, columns headed 1 to 5 and a total; four labelled rows of 0s and 1s with totals 2, 2, 2 and 0 (labels perhaps Division, Multiplication, Subtraction and a fourth); not read with certainty"

name: L004-3
title: BAB/L/004 No. 4.3, 16 Aug 1837
text:
% BAB/L/004, Science Museum Group Collection, document aa110001607.
% The third of three tables on the opened sheet (image 222/630, lower
% left). Numbered 3 on the cover. Read from the zoom images at full
% resolution.

Sheet BAB/L/004
No. 4.3
Date 16 Aug 1837          "16 Aug 1837 No 4"   % cover
Title "Reduction of the same two equations ax + by + c = 0, a'x + b'y + c' = 0 to a single equation of the form Ky - M = 0"
Image 222/628 cover: "3 Reduction of the same two Equations, viz ax + by + c = 0 & a'x + b'y + c' = 0 to a single one of the form Ky - M = 0" (K written over H)
Image 222/630 the third table

Letters a b c a' b' c'
Unknowns x y
Equation a x + b y + c = 0
Equation a' x + b' y + c' = 0

Store v1 = a, v2 = b, v3 = c, v4 = a', v5 = b', v6 = c'
Working v7

% No right-hand column, no composition. The mill column writes "a'/a = A",
% "Ab - b' = K", "c' - Ac = -M"; the cells "A", "K", "-M".
Op 1     ÷  | a'/a      | v1 0, v4 0, v7 =A |
Op 2     ×  | Ab        | v1 Ab, v2 0, v7 0 |
Op 3     ×  | Ac        | v3 0, v4 Ac |             % nothing else in the row: A is in no column (v7 was left at zero by row 2)
Op 4     −  | Ab-b'     | v1 0, v2 =K, v5 0 |
Op 5     −  | c'-Ac     | v3 c'-Ac, v4 0, v6 0 |    % the mill writes "c' - Ac = -M", the cell "-M"

% Cover, right of 3: "var. and opns as in 2", that is:
States great 3, small 2, total 5, variables 6, working 1, occupied 7

name: L005
title: BAB/L/005 No. 5, 16 Aug 1837
text:
% BAB/L/005, Science Museum Group Collection, document aa110001611.
% The opened sheet (image 222/636), one table of 34 operations. The cover
% (222/634) is dated "16 Aug 1837 No 5"; the table "16 Aug 1837" at its top
% right; the back (222/638) "No 5 16 Aug 1837". Read from the zoom images at
% full resolution. ∂ on the sheet is written d here.

Sheet BAB/L/005
No. 5
Date 16 Aug 1837          "16 Aug 1837 No 5"   % cover
Title "Reductions of the three equations ax + by + cz + d = 0, a'x + b'y + c'z + d' = 0, a''x + b''y + c''z + d'' = 0 to two equations of the form Hx + Ky + M = 0 and H'x + K'y + M' = 0"
Image 222/634 cover: "Notation For the Reduction of the Three Equations ... To Two equations of the form Hx + Ky + M = 0, H'x + K'y + M' = 0. Mode of operation made use of in this Notation: (c'+c'')/c and (c+c'')/c' are calculated"
Image 222/636 the table
Image 222/638 back: "No 5 16 Aug 1837"

Letters a b c d a' b' c' d' a'' b'' c'' d''

% The cover: "whence ((c'+c'')/c a - a' - a'')x + ((c'+c'')/c b - b' - b'')y
% + ((c'+c'')/c d - d' - d'') = 0 or Hx + Ky + M = 0", and the same with
% (c+c'')/c' for H', K', M'.
Find H = (c'+c'')/c·a-a'-a''
Find K = (c'+c'')/c·b-b'-b''
Find M = (c'+c'')/c·d-d'-d''
Find H' = (c+c'')/c'·a'-a-a''
Find K' = (c+c'')/c'·b'-b-b''
Find M' = (c+c'')/c'·d'-d-d''

% The store is headed +ax +by +cz +d over v1-v4, +a'x +b'y +c'z +d' over
% v5-v8, +a''x +b''y +c''z +d'' over v9-v12, and, above the right-hand
% column, "v1 = a v2 = b ... v12 = d''". v13-v15 have no heading.
Store v1 = a, v2 = b, v3 = c, v4 = d, v5 = a', v6 = b', v7 = c', v8 = d', v9 = a'', v10 = b'', v11 = c'', v12 = d''
Working v13 v14 v15

% "Com. c'" and the like are written in words; here Cc'. Rows with no
% species and nothing in the mill column are transfers. The mill column
% writes "= A", "= B", "= H" and so on under rows 6, 7, 14, 16, 18, 30, 32,
% 34; the store cells write "= A", "= B" in rows 6 and 7 and H, K, M, M',
% K', H' in rows 14 to 34; the column before the right-hand one writes
% "H =", "K =", "M =", "M' =", "K' =", "H' =".
Op 1     +  | c'+c''      | v7 0, v11 0, v13 c'+c'', v14 Cc', v15 Cc''   | v13 = v7+v11
Op 2        |             | v7 c', v14 0                                 | v7' = c'
Op 3        |             | v11 c'', v15 0                               | v11' = c''
Op 4     +  | c+c''       | v3 0, v11 0, v14 Cc, v15 c+c''               | v15' = v3+v11'
Op 5        |             | v3 c, v14 0                                  | v3' = c
Op 6     ÷  | (c'+c'')/c  | v3 0, v11 =A, v13 0                          | v11'' = v13/v3'
Op 7     ÷  | (c+c'')/c'  | v7 0, v13 =B, v15 0                          | v13' = v15'/v7'
Op 8     ×  | Aa          | v1 0, v7 Ca, v11 0, v15 Aa                   | v15'' = v11''·v1
Op 9     ×  | Ab          | v2 0, v3 Cb, v14 Ab                          | v14'' = v11''·v2
Op 10    ×  | Ad          | v1 Ad, v4 0, v11 Cd                          | v1' = v11''·v4
Op 11    −  | Aa-a'       | v2 Aa-a', v4 Ca', v5 0, v15 0                | v2' = v15''-v5
Op 12    −  | Ab-b'       | v5 Cb', v6 0, v14 0, v15 Ab-b'               | v15''' = v14''-v6
Op 13    −  | Ad-d'       | v1 0, v6 Cd', v8 0, v14 Ad-d'                | v14''' = v1'-v8
Op 14    −  | Aa-a'-a''   | v1 =H, v2 0, v8 Ca'', v9 0                   | H = v1'' = v2'-v9
Op 15       |             | v3 0, v9 b                                   | v9' = b
Op 16    −  | Ab-b'-b''   | v2 =K, v3 Cb'', v10 0, v15 0                 | K = v2'' = v15'''-v10
Op 17       |             | v3 0, v10 b''                                | v10' = b''
Op 18    −  | Ad-d'-d''   | v3 =M, v12 0, v14 0, v15 Cd''                | M = v3'''' = v14'''-v12   % the species looks like "="
Op 19       |             | v14 d'', v15 0                               | v14'''' = d''
Op 20       |             | v8 0, v12 a''                                | v12' = a''
Op 21       |             | v6 0, v8 d'                                  | v8'' = d'
Op 22       |             | v5 0, v6 b'                                  | v6'' = b'
Op 23       |             | v4 0, v5 a'                                  | v5'' = a'
Op 24       |             | v4 a, v7 0                                   | v4'' = a
Op 25       |             | v7 d, v11 0                                  | v7''' = d
Op 26    ×  | Ba'         | v5 0, v11 Ba', v13 0                         | v11'''' = v13'·v5''
Op 27    ×  | Bb'         | v6 0, v15 Bb'                                | v15''''' = v13'·v6''
Op 28    ×  | Bd'         | v5 Bd', v8 0                                 | v5''' = v13'·v8''
Op 29    −  | Bd'-d       | v5 0, v7 0, v8 Bd'-d                         | v8''' = v5'''-v7'''       % a small mark above the −
Op 30    −  | Bd'-d-d''   | v7 =M', v8 0, v14 0                          | M' = v7'''' = v8'''-v14''''
Op 31    −  | Bb'-b       | v5 Bb'-b, v9 0, v15 0                        | v5'''' = v15'''''-v9'
Op 32    −  | Bb'-b-b''   | v5 0, v6 =K', v10 0                          | K' = v6''' = v5''''-v10'
Op 33    −  | Ba'-a       | v4 0, v8 Ba'-a, v11 0                        | v8'''' = v11''''-v4''
Op 34    −  | Ba'-a-a''   | v5 =H', v8 0, v12 0                          | H' = v5''''' = v8''''-v12'

% The right-hand column continues on rows 14, 16, 18, 30, 32 and 34. The
% sheet writes accents iv and v as roman numerals; here as primes.
Composition H = v1'' = v2'-v9 = (v15''-v5)-a'' = v11''·v1-a'-a'' = v13/v3'·a-a'-a'' = (v7+v11)/c·a-a'-a'' = (c'+c'')/c·a-a'-a'' = (a(c'+c'')-c(a'+a''))/c
Composition K = v2'' = v15'''-v10 = (v14''-v6)-b'' = v11''·v2-b'-b'' = v13/v3'·b-b'-b'' = (v7+v11)/c·b-b'-b'' = (c'+c'')/c·b-b'-b'' = (b(c'+c'')-c(b'+b''))/c
Composition M = v3'''' = v14'''-v12 = (v1'-v8)-d'' = v11''·v4-d'-d'' = v13/v3'·d-d'-d'' = (v7+v11)/c·d-d'-d'' = (c'+c'')/c·d-d'-d'' = (d(c'+c'')-c(d'+d''))/c
Composition M' = v7'''' = v8'''-v14'''' = v5'''-v7'''-d'' = v13'·v8''-d-d'' = v15'/v7'·d'-d-d'' = (v3+v11')/c'·d'-d-d'' = (c+c'')/c'·d'-d-d'' = (d'(c+c'')-c'(d+d''))/c'
Composition K' = v6''' = v5''''-v10' = v15'''''-v9'-b'' = v13'·v6''-b-b'' = v15'/v7'·b'-b-b'' = (v3+v11')/c'·b'-b-b'' = (c+c'')/c'·b'-b-b'' = (b'(c+c'')-c'(b+b''))/c'
% Row 34: after v13'·v5''-a-a'' the sheet writes v15'/v7' a'-a-a'' (the
% accented a' written so that it looks like d) with a slanting stroke through
% it; that member is left out here.
Composition H' = v5''''' = v8''''-v12' = v11''''-v4''-a'' = v13'·v5''-a-a'' = (v3+v11')/c'·a'-a-a'' = (c+c'')/c'·a'-a-a'' = (a'(c+c'')-c'(a+a''))/c'

% Pencil on the cover, in a hand unlike Babbage's ink: "15 variables are
% required & 26 small operations & 8 large = 34 operations - There are 6
% Multiplications & 2 divisions".
States great 8, small 26, total 34, occupied 15

Remark "resulting equation equivalent to 1/c {a(c'+c'')-c(a'+a'')}x + {b(c'+c'')-c(b'+b'')}y + d(c'+c'')-c(d'+d'') = 0"
Remark "resulting equation equivalent to 1/c' {a'(c+c'')-c'(a+a'')}x + {b'(c+c'')-c'(b+b'')}y + d'(c+c'')-c'(d+d'') = 0"
Unrun "cover, pencil, in another hand: 'In this method, which is by adding the coefficients of z in the 2nd & 3rd eqns & dividing by the coefficient of z in the 1st, thus obtaining a multiplier for the first eqn which equalizes the coeff of z in the 1st with the sum of those of the 2nd & 3rd & eliminates z, 15 variables are required & 26 small operations & 8 large = 34 operations - There are 6 Multiplications & 2 divisions - see Not. 5'"
Unrun "a column of numbers 1 to 34 between v12 and v13, repeating the numbers of the operations"
Unrun "back, top right: faint writing, not read"

name: L006
title: BAB/L/006 No. 6
text:
% BAB/L/006, Science Museum Group Collection, document aa110001614.
% The opened sheet (image 222/642), one table of 18 operations. The cover
% (222/640) is marked "No 6" and is not dated; nor is the table. Rojas
% (2017, Table 3) dates program 6 "8.1837". Read from the zoom images at
% full resolution.

Sheet BAB/L/006
No. 6
Title "Notation For the reduction of the three Equations ax + by + cz + d = 0, a'x + b'y + c'z + d' = 0, a''x + b''y + c''z + d'' = 0 To two Equations of the form Hx + Ky + M = 0, H'x + K'y + M' = 0"
Image 222/640 cover: the equations, the "Mode of operating used in this Notation", and a paragraph beginning "The Notation fails"
Image 222/642 the table
Image 222/644 back: "No 6" only

% The sheet writes d as a round-backed ∂; here d.
Letters a b c d a' b' c' d' a'' b'' c'' d''

% The cover: "c'/c and c''/c are calculated", "whence (c'/c a - a')x +
% (c'/c b - b')y + (c'/c d - d'')= 0 or Hx + Ky + M = 0" (the cover writes
% d'' in the first and c''/c before by in the line above it, where the
% working needs d' and c'/c; the table has neither slip), "also ... whence
% (c''/c a - a'')x + (c''/c b - b'')y + (c''/c d - d'')= 0 or H'x + K'y + M' = 0".
Find H = (c'/c)a-a'
Find K = (c'/c)b-b'
Find M = (c'/c)d-d'
Find H' = (c''/c)a-a''
Find K' = (c''/c)b-b''
Find M' = (c''/c)d-d''

% The store is headed with the three equations, ax +by +cz +d = 0 over
% v1 to v4, a'x +b'y +c'z +d' = 0 over v5 to v8, a''x +b''y +c''z +d'' = 0
% over v9 to v12; then v13 to v18.
Store v1 = a, v2 = b, v3 = c, v4 = d, v5 = a', v6 = b', v7 = c', v8 = d', v9 = a'', v10 = b'', v11 = c'', v12 = d''
Working v13 v14 v15 v16 v17 v18

% The right-hand column is headed "Composition". The sheet writes each row
% with the formula first and the variable written last ("v7/v3 = v13",
% "v13·v1 = v7/v3 v1 = v7'"); here the variable written comes first, as the
% notation requires, and the rest follows in the sheet's order.
% "Comp. c", "Comp a", "Comp. b", "Comp. ∂" are written in words; here Cc,
% Ca, Cb, Cd. The mill writes c'/c a as a fraction followed by a; here (c'/c)a.
Op 1     ÷  | c'/c          | v3 0, v7 0, v13 c'/c, v14 Cc        | v13 = v7/v3
Op 2     ×  | (c'/c)a       | v1 0, v7 (c'/c)a, v13 0, v15 Ca     | v7' = v13·v1 = v7/v3·v1
Op 3     ×  | (c'/c)b       | v2 0, v13 (c'/c)b, v16 Cb           | v13' = v13·v2 = v7/v3·v2
Op 4     ×  | (c'/c)d       | v4 0, v17 Cd, v18 (c'/c)d           | v18 = v13·v4 = v7/v3·v4
% Rows 5 and 7 to 9: no operation and nothing in the mill. The sheet writes
% "v14 = v3' = v3", "v15 = v1' = v1", "v16 = v2' = v2", "v17 = v4' = v4".
Op 5        |               | v3 c, v14 0                         | v3' = v3
% Row 6's middle member is written v1?/v3 with the second digit of 11
% blotted, perhaps 14 corrected to 11 or the reverse; the same blot is in
% row 11's v1?/v3. Read as v11, which the other rows (v11/v3 in rows 10 and
% 12) have.
Op 6     ÷  | c''/c         | v3 0, v11 0, v14 c''/c              | v14' = v11/v3' = v11/v3
Op 7        |               | v1 a, v15 0                         | v1' = v1
Op 8        |               | v2 b, v16 0                         | v2' = v2
Op 9        |               | v4 d, v17 0                         | v4' = v4
% Rows 10 to 12 name v1, v2, v4 without accents, though each now holds its
% second number (the same a, b, d brought back).
Op 10    ×  | (c''/c)a      | v1 0, v14 0, v15 (c''/c)a           | v15' = v14'·v1 = v11/v3·v1
Op 11    ×  | (c''/c)b      | v2 0, v16 (c''/c)b                  | v16' = v14'·v2 = v11/v3·v2
Op 12    ×  | (c''/c)d      | v4 0, v17 (c''/c)d                  | v17' = v14'·v4 = v11/v3·v4
% Rows 13 to 18: the mill column ends with "=", and the store cell holds the
% letter (H, K, M, H', K', M'); the right-hand column runs on, "= v1'' = H =
% c'/c a - a'".
Op 13    −  | (c'/c)a-a'    | v1 =H, v5 0, v7 0                   | v1'' = v7'-v5 = v7/v3·v1-v5 = H = (c'/c)a-a'
Op 14    −  | (c'/c)b-b'    | v2 =K, v6 0, v13 0                  | v2'' = v13'-v6 = v7/v3·v2-v6 = K = (c'/c)b-b'
Op 15    −  | (c'/c)d-d'    | v4 =M, v8 0, v18 0                  | v4'' = v18-v8 = v7/v3·v4-v8 = M = (c'/c)d-d'
% Row 16's mill: the second letter's first accent touches its bowl, so that
% it could be taken for d''; the sheet's d is always the round-backed ∂, and
% the right-hand column has c''/c a - a''. Read as a''.
Op 16    −  | (c''/c)a-a''  | v5 =H', v9 0, v15 0                 | v5' = v15'-v9 = v11/v3·v1-v9 = H' = (c''/c)a-a''
Op 17    −  | (c''/c)b-b''  | v6 =K', v10 0, v16 0                | v6' = v16'-v10 = v11/v3·v2-v10 = K' = (c''/c)b-b''
Op 18    −  | (c''/c)d-d''  | v8 =M', v12 0, v17 0                | v8' = v17'-v12 = v11/v3·v4-v12 = M' = (c''/c)d-d''

% The cover, in a paler hand (pencil or faded ink): "This requires 18
% variables - 10 small & 8 large operations = 18 Operations There are 8
% multiplications & 2 divisions - See Not. 5".
States great 8, small 10, total 18, occupied 18

Remark "When H/H' = K/K' = G then G = M/M' or when H/H' = K/K' = M/M'"
Remark "The Notation fails - The failure is not a necessary consequence of the method made use of in the Not - but the fault lies in the given equations"
Remark "In the method, the coeffts. of z in the 2nd & 3rd equations are divided by that of z in the 1st - the former quot. multiplied into the 1st equation equalizes the coeffts of z in the 2nd & the resulting eqn"
% The table has 6 multiplications and 2 divisions: 8 great operations, as
% "8 large operations" says, but not "8 multiplications & 2 divisions".
Unrun "cover: 'There are 8 multiplications & 2 divisions - See Not. 5'"
Unrun "cover, pencil, left margin beside the second 'whence': 'also'"
Unrun "table, faint pencil in the empty column after the mill, row 7: perhaps 'ca - ch' (not read)"

name: L007
title: BAB/L/007 No. 7, before 22 Aug 1837
text:
% BAB/L/007, Science Museum Group Collection, document aa110001618.
% The opened sheet (image 222/653), one table of 37 operations. The cover
% (222/650) is marked "No 7" in ink and "before 22 Aug 1837" in pencil, in
% what looks like another hand. Read from the zoom images at full resolution.

Sheet BAB/L/007
No. 7
Date before 22 Aug 1837          "before 22 Aug 1837"   % cover, pencil, perhaps a later hand
Title "Notation of the Reduction of the four equations ax + by + cz + du + e = 0, a'x + b'y + c'z + d'u + e' = 0, a''x + … = 0, a'''x + … = 0 (A) To three equations of the following form Hx + Ky + Lz + M = 0, H'x + K'y + L'z + M' = 0, H''x + K''y + L''z + M'' = 0 (B)"
Image 222/650 cover: "Mode of operating. The first of the equations A being multiplied by d'/d and the second subtracted from the result gives the first equation B. The first of the equations A being multiplied by d''/d and the third subtracted from the result gives the second equation B. The first of the equations A being multiplied by d'''/d and the fourth subtracted from the result gives the third equation B"
Image 222/653 the table
Image 222/648 a second ruled sheet, the same layout in faint pencil
Image 222/646 back

Letters a b c d e a' b' c' d' e' a'' b'' c'' d'' e'' a''' b''' c''' d''' e'''

% The sheet heads the store with the four equations, a coefficient over
% each column; d is written ∂ throughout.
Store v1 = a, v2 = b, v3 = c, v4 = d, v5 = e, v6 = a', v7 = b', v8 = c', v9 = d', v10 = e', v11 = a'', v12 = b'', v13 = c'', v14 = d'', v15 = e'', v16 = a''', v17 = b''', v18 = c''', v19 = d''', v20 = e'''
Working v21 v22 v23 v24 v25 v26 v27

% No right-hand column of formulas: each row is the operation, the mill's
% result and the cells. The operation numbers are repeated in a narrow
% column between v13 and v14. "Comp a" and the like are written in words;
% here Ca. H, K, L, M and their accents are the sheet's; =H marks where the
% sheet writes H.
Op 1     ÷  | d'/d            | v4 0, v9 0, v21 d'/d, v22 Cd |
Op 2     ×  | (d'/d)a         | v1 0, v4 Ca, v21 0, v23 (d'/d)a |
Op 3     ×  | (d'/d)b         | v1 Cb, v2 0, v24 (d'/d)b |
Op 4     ×  | (d'/d)c         | v2 Cc, v3 0, v25 (d'/d)c |
Op 5     ×  | (d'/d)e         | v3 Ce, v5 0, v26 (d'/d)e |
Op 6        |                 | v3 0, v5 e |
Op 7        |                 | v2 0, v3 c |
Op 8        |                 | v1 0, v2 b |
Op 9        |                 | v1 a, v4 0 |
Op 10       |                 | v4 d, v22 0 |
Op 11    ÷  | d''/d           | v4 0, v14 0, v21 d''/d, v22 Cd |
Op 12    ×  | (d''/d)a        | v1 0, v4 Ca, v9 (d''/d)a, v21 0 |
Op 13    ×  | (d''/d)b        | v1 Cb, v2 0, v14 (d''/d)b |
Op 14    ×  | (d''/d)c        | v2 Cc, v3 0, v21 (d''/d)c |
Op 15    ×  | (d''/d)e        | v3 Ce, v5 0, v27 (d''/d)e |
Op 16       |                 | v3 0, v5 e |
Op 17       |                 | v2 0, v3 c |
Op 18       |                 | v1 0, v2 b |
Op 19       |                 | v1 a, v4 0 |
Op 20       |                 | v4 d, v22 0 |
Op 21    ÷  | d'''/d          | v4 0, v19 0, v22 d'''/d |       % no complement of d: d is not needed again
Op 22    ×  | (d'''/d)a       | v1 0, v19 (d'''/d)a |           % nothing in v22: the sheet does not write the 0 for d'''/d taken from it
Op 23    ×  | (d'''/d)b       | v2 0, v4 (d'''/d)b |
Op 24    ×  | (d'''/d)c       | v2 (d'''/d)c, v3 0 |
Op 25    ×  | (d'''/d)e       | v3 (d'''/d)e, v5 0 |
Op 26    −  | (d'''/d)e-e'''  | v3 0, v5 =M'', v20 0 |
Op 27    −  | (d'''/d)c-c'''  | v2 0, v3 =L'', v18 0 |           % the c after d'''/d is written over an e
Op 28    −  | (d'''/d)b-b'''  | v2 =K'', v4 0, v17 0 |
Op 29    −  | (d'''/d)a-a'''  | v1 =H'', v16 0, v19 0 |
Op 30    −  | (d'/d)a-a'      | v6 0, v16 =H, v23 0 |
Op 31    −  | (d'/d)b-b'      | v7 0, v17 =K, v24 0 |
Op 32    −  | (d'/d)c-c'      | v8 0, v18 =L, v25 0 |
Op 33    −  | (d'/d)e-e'      | v10 0, v20 =M, v26 0 |
Op 34    −  | (d''/d)a-a''    | v6 =H', v9 0, v11 0 |
Op 35    −  | (d'/d)b-b''     | v7 =K', v12 0, v14 0 |           % the mill column has one accent on the d of the numerator, ∂′, plainly
Op 36    −  | (d''/d)c-c''    | v8 =L', v13 0, v21 0 |
Op 37    −  | (d''/d)e-e''    | v10 =M', v15 0, v27 0 |

% Cover, pencil, faint: "Variables 20", "working 7", "Total 27"; beside it a
% column of operations, perhaps "Division 3", "Mult 12", "Sub 12", and a
% fourth of 10, with "37" beside. The variables and the total are read with
% some confidence, the operations not.
States variables 20, working 7, occupied 27, total 37

Unrun "a column of numbers 1 to 37 between v13 and v14, repeating the numbers of the operations; a 38 below it, smudged"
Unrun "pencil, faint, in the columns v19 to v27 beside rows 13 to 32: letters such as Ca, Cb, Cd, Ce and 0, as if working out where complements could go"
Unrun "cover, pencil, faint: beside the counts, the numbers of operations by kind (perhaps Division 3, Mult 12, Sub 12, and 10), not read with confidence"
Unrun "image 222/648: a second ruled sheet with the same headings and layout in faint pencil, a draft or copy of the table; not read"
